// 1. O(n) sliding window sum
function slidingWindowDigest(arr, winSize) {
  var sum = 0, acc = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    sum += arr[i];
    if (i >= winSize) sum -= arr[i - winSize];
    acc = (acc + hashValue(sum)) | 0;
  }
  return acc;
}

// 2. O(n^2) quadratic insertion sort using shared compareAsc()
function insertionSort(input) {
  var arr = input.slice();
  for (var i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
    var key = arr[i];
    var j = i - 1;
    while (j >= 0 && compareAsc(arr[j], key) > 0) {
      arr[j + 1] = arr[j];
      j--;
    }
    arr[j + 1] = key;
  }
  return arr;
}

// 3. O(n^2) quadratic pairwise distance matrix reduction
function pairwiseDistanceSum(arr) {
  var acc = 0;
  var limit = Math.min(arr.length, 24);
  for (var i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
    for (var j = i + 1; j < limit; j++) {
      var diff = arr[i] - arr[j];
      acc += diff < 0 ? -diff : diff;
    }
  }
  return acc;
}

var sortedQuad = insertionSort(sharedData);
var total = checksum(sortedQuad) ^ slidingWindowDigest(sortedQuad, 4);
total = (total + pairwiseDistanceSum(sortedQuad)) | 0;
sink = total;
